identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Classify and fix Unity ILPP GetDomainName loop in observatory batch proof

values.task_boundary: Implement only the ILPP loop classifier, controlled diagnosis, and proven root-cause repair on the current v0.91.8 base.
deliverables: Reusable ILPP and progress classifier surface
Controlled environment-matrix runner or retained command packet
Minimal proven root-cause fix or exact blocker disposition
Operator diagnosis note with ownership routing
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: the complete connectivity, gRPC or type-initialization, and GetDomainName -1 signature family is reproducible in one approved staged proof or retained fixture derived from exact evidence
AC-2: repeated complete signatures without semantic progress classify as ilpp_retry_loop without waiting for an arbitrary total runtime ceiling
AC-3: import, compile, validator, or terminal progress resets the non-progress classifier and preserves successful batch behavior
AC-4: readonly-database text remains a separate classifier and is not fatal after verified staged import progress

AC-5: the controlled matrix declares isolated, host-HOME, and system-temp cells with one named variable group changed per comparison, records host capability before staging, and permits an approved-host isolated proof

AC-6: each matrix cell retains Unity version, source project, staged-project state as an actual path or not_created, non-secret environment shape, semantic progress markers, signature counts, terminal classification, and issue-local log references
AC-7: the minimal root-cause fix is applied only after the matrix isolates its owner; otherwise the exact current blocker and owner are recorded

AC-8: focused no-Unity tests cover incomplete signature, complete repeating loop, progress reset, readonly progression, normal ILPP start, default and single-cell matrix selection, evidence fields, path confinement, and status aggregation
AC-9: one safe staged regression reaches the existing Observatory validator success marker or records a precise post-ILPP blocker without claiming full demo readiness
AC-10: the final diff excludes #4739 MCP internals, #4741 general liveness and mode selection, Unity scene code, runtime semantics, asset work, and rendering polish

AC-11: validation selector registration preserves the existing Unity liveness and contract lane, maps the new classifier, matrix runner, matrix test, and diagnosis paths to a focused Unity ILPP lane whose command reruns wrapper and unit proof, and its selector test passes
dependencies: #4741 safe fresh_batch mode or equivalent exact staged-project ownership proof
WP-15 #5354 consumes the final proof or exact blocker
repo_inputs: retained ILPP GetDomainName error family from #4741
non_goals: Do not redesign Unity proof-mode selection
Do not repair Unity-MCP endpoint alignment
Do not modify Unity scene builder or validator semantics
Do not add asset fallback or investor-facing polish
Do not build owner binaries or use /private/tmp
Do not dump complete environment or host process state
